BiblicalUsage: Upon man's flesh shall it not be poured, says the Lord of the holy anointing oil, neither shall ye make any other like it.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the pouring is guarded because the oil is holy: it may not be poured on common flesh, and no copy may be made, and the restriction itself teaches that what God sets apart is not ours to use as we please.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
